channel.title: Devin Desaulniers' Greater Vancouver Real Estate Blog
channel.description: Greater Vancouver and Tri-Cities, BC real estate news, explained in plain language by Devin Desaulniers, Real Estate Associate with Axford Real Estate.

item.title: Moving to Coquitlam from another province: what should I know about neighbourhoods, costs and the commute?
item.dc:creator: Devin Desaulniers
item.description: Pick the Coquitlam neighbourhood that fits your commute, then budget the asking rent or the benchmark price for that kind of home. SkyTrain times, October 2025 rents and September 2026 sale prices.

item.title: Canada's Big Six posted $69.9B. Shop your mortgage.
item.dc:creator: Devin Desaulniers
item.description: Canada's Big Six posted $69.9 billion in reported net income for fiscal 2025, or C$69.861 billion combined. When a Greater Vancouver renewal or pre-approval comes up, shop it.

item.title: B.C.'s sales-to-active listings ratio was 12% in September
item.dc:creator: Devin Desaulniers
item.description: BCREA's September tables put B.C.'s sales-to-active listings ratio at 12%, with 43,940 homes listed, down 4.3% from a year ago. What that means in Greater Vancouver and the Tri-Cities, BC.

item.title: B.C. September home sales fell 8.9% from last year
item.dc:creator: Devin Desaulniers
item.description: The B.C. Real Estate Association says 5,254 homes sold in September 2026, down 8.9% from a year ago and 25.8% below the 10-year average for the month. The average price was $924,279.

item.title: Vancouver's housing permits got faster. The record is mixed.
item.dc:creator: Devin Desaulniers
item.description: The Tyee's October 13 review of Vancouver council: ABC says 92% of renovation permits now go out within three days, and 896 multiplex homes were approved by the end of 2025. The party also says it missed its own speed targets.

item.title: Who still owns a home in Canada? 66.5%, and B.C. is right on average
item.dc:creator: Devin Desaulniers
item.description: Everyone says nobody owns a home in Canada anymore. The 2021 Census says 66.5% do — down from 69.0% in 2011. B.C. sits at 66.8%, basically dead-on the national rate.

item.title: Vancouver-area unemployment rose to 7.1% in September
item.dc:creator: Devin Desaulniers
item.description: Statistics Canada says the Vancouver-area unemployment rate rose to 7.1% in September 2026, from 6.5% in August. B.C. lost 20,200 jobs, and construction had the largest drop.

item.title: How do I rent in Vancouver before I move?
item.dc:creator: Devin Desaulniers
item.description: Yes. You can line up a Greater Vancouver rental before you arrive: prepare your papers, sign a written tenancy agreement, and pay no more than half a month's rent as a security deposit.

item.title: What $190,000 actually leaves you after tax and rent
item.dc:creator: Devin Desaulniers
item.description: I ran a $190,000 salary through 2026 federal and provincial tax, CPP/EI and 12 months of average one-bedroom rent. Edmonton has $116,711 left; Vancouver is 8th at $102,376, within $101 of Ottawa.

item.title: Vancouver asking rents rose in September, still below last year
item.dc:creator: Devin Desaulniers
item.description: Rentals.ca and Urbanation say Vancouver apartment and condo asking rents rose 1.4% in September to $2,741, the largest monthly gain among Canada's six largest markets, but they're still 1.3% below a year ago.

item.title: Canada's best cities for work in 2026: Vancouver is 4th for pay, last for rent
item.dc:creator: Devin Desaulniers
item.description: I built a Canadian version of the viral \"Best Cities for Work\" map, ranking our 23 biggest metros on public StatCan and CMHC data. Vancouver lands 11th: top 5 for pay, dead last for pay vs. rent.

item.title: Metro Vancouver's September home sales: a condo slowdown, not a market-wide one
item.dc:creator: Devin Desaulniers
item.description: Greater Vancouver REALTORS® says September sales fell 8.4% from last year, but the drop was almost all apartments. Here's my plain-language read and what it means if you're buying, selling or renting.
